For the rest of this turn, you may play characters from your discard. If you do, they enter play exerted and you can't play characters with the same name as characters you played this way this turn.

record.author: Javi Salas
record.name: Rapunzel
record.rules_text: \Picture Perfect\ Whenever this character quests, you may choose another character and reveal a character card in your hand. If they have the same name, draw a card.
record.subtitle: Outgoing Artist

record.author: Gaku Kumatori
record.name: Merlin
record.rules_text:
\Untapped Potential\ When you play this character, get 1 ink drop.

\Thrilling Discovery\ Whenever this character quests, draw a card.
record.subtitle: Profoundly Curious

record.author: Elodie Mondoloni
record.name: Un Poco Loco
record.rules_text:
<Sing Together> 3

Choose 2 characters of yours. If one of them is cost 3 or less, return both to your hand.

record.author: Kendall Hale
record.name: Max Goof
record.rules_text:
\Sweet Remix\ When you play this character, you may choose and discard a song card. If you do, draw 2 cards.

\Brand-New Playlist\ While you have 5 or more song cards in your discard, this character gets +3 {L}.
record.subtitle: Karaoke Star

record.author: Brianna Garcia
record.name: Belle
record.rules_text:
<Shift> 3 {I}

\Hyperia City Tips\ During your turn, whenever this character exerts, you pay 2 {I} less for the next action you play this turn.

\Hyperia City Secrets\ During your turn, whenever you play a third action, gain 3 lore.
record.subtitle: Exceptional Writer

record.author: Wouter Bruneel
record.name: Shere Khan
record.rules_text: \Quietly Released\ When you play this character, put chosen opposing character with 3 {S} or less on the bottom of their player's deck.
record.subtitle: Ruthless Entrepreneur

record.author: Bill Robinson
record.name: Héctor Rivera
record.rules_text:
<Shift> 4 {I}

\Big Hit\ Whenever this character quests and whenever he sings a song for the first time each turn, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a song card and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your discard.
record.subtitle: Worldwide Sensation

record.author: Alice Pisoni
record.name: Pepita
record.rules_text:
<Shift> 3 {I} 

\Ancestral Wisdom\ While you have 10 or more cards in your discard, this character gets +2 {S} and +2 {L}.
record.subtitle: Imelda's Right Hand

record.author: LadyShalirin / Eri Welli
record.name: Mulan
record.rules_text:
\Way of the Hero\ When you play this character, chosen character gets +2 {S} and gains "Whenever this character challenges another character, draw a card" this turn.

\Warrior Spirit\ Whenever this character quests, chosen character gains <Rush> this turn.
record.subtitle: Martial Arts Master

record.author: Saulo Nate
record.name: Thomas O'Malley
record.rules_text: \Lucky Break\ Whenever this character quests, each player reveals the top card of their deck. Put the card with the highest cost revealed this way, or each card tied for highest cost, into its player's hand. Put the rest on the bottom of their players' decks.
record.subtitle: Savvy Vagabond

record.author: Malia Ewart
record.name: Ariel
record.rules_text:
\One of a Kind\ Whenever you play an item, if the item you played has a different name than each other item you have in play, draw a card.

\Personal Collection\ For each item with a different name you have in play, this character gets +1 {L}.
record.subtitle: Collector of Oddities

record.author: Brian Weisz
record.name: Marie
record.rules_text: \A Little Treat\ Whenever this character quests, if an opposing character took damage this turn, get 1 ink drop.
record.subtitle: Caught in the Act

record.author: Pernille Orum
record.name: Tiana
record.rules_text:
<Shift> 5 {I}

\Ideal Venue\ When you play this character, you may draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card. If you discarded a location card this way, you may play it from your discard for free.
record.subtitle: Party Hostess

record.author: Lisanne Koeteeuw
record.name: Raya
record.rules_text: \To the Ends of the Realm\ This character gets +1 {L} for each location you have in play.
record.subtitle: Determined Explorer

record.author: Clio Schaffner
record.name: Cinderella
record.rules_text:
<Shift> 5 {I}

\Bespoke Design\ At the end of your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on either the top or the bottom of your deck and the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
record.subtitle: Unintentional Icon
